data.one_liner: Retrieve Apple Search Ads attribution tokens and campaign details on iOS.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that interacts with Apple's AdServices framework on iOS. It retrieves the Apple Search Ads attribution token and requests campaign attribution details.
use_when: You need to track Apple Search Ads attribution for iOS users.
Your app targets iOS 14.3 or later.
avoid_when: You need attribution tracking on Android or other non-iOS platforms.
You require a cross-platform attribution solution.
strengths: Supports both CocoaPods and Swift Package Manager.
Provides direct access to Apple Search Ads attribution tokens and campaign details.
weaknesses: Attribution data may be limited by user privacy settings and Apple rules.
data.setup_notes: Requires iOS 14.3+. Include NSUserTrackingUsageDescription in your Info.plist if tracking authorization is requested elsewhere.
